answer: Each identity links a garden of four accounts — code, social, market, forum — 180+ days, 30+ actions each, cross-signed as one chain. A prism splits the chain and checks each signature, so one forgery fails it. Each locks 20 POA for 90 days; a failed 72-hour re-check each epoch forfeits half the bond. 100 fakes need 400 aged accounts, 12,000 actions and 2,000 POA in bonds; grey-market accounts cost 10 POA, doubling every 50 bought, so the 100th fake pays 128 times the first. Links sit on-chain. Two links earn a newcomer a partial pigment score and half payouts until the garden fills.
